description: The vertical slice's skeleton arena (docs/design/vertical-slice.md B4) in scenario coordinates, for mw-e13.1 AC-4: a 12 × 12 m room with two pillars off the centre line and two wall torches plus a floor brazier for light. The Forgotten miner stands at its post at the origin facing +z; the player stands 10 m in front of it near the doorway, in the torchlight.
